explanation: Khayyam was also a mathematician and astronomer who helped reform the Persian calendar. FitzGerald's loose English version of the quatrains appeared in 1859.

claims.text: The quatrains of the Rubaiyat that Edward FitzGerald made famous in English are attributed to Omar Khayyam.
The Rubaiyat translated by FitzGerald is not attributed to Hafez, Ferdowsi or Saadi.
Omar Khayyam was a mathematician and astronomer who took part in reforming the Persian calendar (the Jalali calendar).
FitzGerald's English version, The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam, was first published in 1859.
